data.name: Masterpiece
data.description: The argent dramaturge gains a bardic masterpiece without needing to sacrifice a feat or spell known. She must still meet the prerequisites of the masterpiece. An argent dramaturge can take this flourish more than once, but must select a new bardic masterpiece each time she does so.
